report.summary:
Patient P-D008 (41, Medicaid via Lakeshore Community Health Plan) screens positive for transportation need despite reporting he drives his own older car. His Medicaid plan includes a transport benefit, making him eligible for non-emergency medical transportation (NEMT). Area context: census tract 17031400800 has 45.7% of households with no vehicle and 61 transit stops within 800m, so transit is available locally. Appointments on file are kept (ED 10/12, primary care 10/22 16:00 at Clinic) but no facility location is on file to run a transit feasibility check.

Recommended transport resources:
- Medicaid Ride Line (NEMT): eligible as a Medicaid plan member; call the number on the member card at least 2 business days ahead of each appointment to schedule a ride.
- Medical ride request form: submit to check what ride assistance the patient qualifies for; response within one business day. Requires name, DOB, Medicaid ID, pickup address, and appointment time.
- Paratransit Info Desk: general paratransit information for the area.
- Senior Shuttle West: noted but likely not age-eligible (patient is 41; senior-focused).
